title: Unit indexing configuration
responsibility: Defines registry locations and default indexing rules and matches the supported path-pattern syntax.

inputs.name: pathMatches.path
inputs.description: Forward-slash path to compare with a pattern.

inputs.name: pathMatches.pattern
inputs.description: Exact path, directory prefix ending slash, or supported wildcard pattern.

outputs.name: unitsConfigSchema
outputs.description: Strict version 1 schema for workspaces, test/global/ignored patterns and declared source-reference mappings.

outputs.name: defaultGlobalFiles
outputs.description: Known root/workspace configuration filenames whose changes can affect every unit and test.

outputs.name: defaultUnitsConfig
outputs.description: Default root workspace, test/ and tests/ patterns, no explicit globals or references, and ignored Markdown, feature/loop specs and .gitignore.

outputs.name: pathMatches
outputs.description: True for exact match, trailing-slash prefix or wildcard match; **/ can span zero or more directories and * remains within a segment.
